description: This file defines the AccessAnalyzerClient class, which is a PHP client for interacting with the AWS Access Analyzer service. It provides method signatures (with annotations) for various API actions related to Access Analyzer, such as creating analyzers, managing archive rules, listing findings, and more.

classes.name: AccessAnalyzerClient
classes.description: Client class used to interact with AWS Access Analyzer service, extending the generic AwsClient class. It provides methods to perform various access analysis operations.

methods.name: applyArchiveRule
methods.description: Applies an archive rule in Access Analyzer.

methods.name: checkAccessNotGranted
methods.description: Checks if access was not granted.

methods.name: checkNoNewAccess
methods.description: Checks if no new access has been granted.

methods.name: checkNoPublicAccess
methods.description: Checks if there is no public access.

methods.name: createAccessPreview
methods.description: Creates a preview of access analysis results.

methods.name: getAccessPreview
methods.description: Retrieves details of an access preview.

methods.name: getAnalyzedResource
methods.description: Returns analysis results for a resource.

methods.name: getAnalyzer
methods.description: Gets details of a specific analyzer.

methods.name: getArchiveRule
methods.description: Retrieves details of an archive rule.

methods.name: getFindingRecommendation
methods.description: Retrieves a recommendation for a specific finding.

methods.name: listAccessPreviewFindings
methods.description: Lists findings for an access preview.

methods.name: listAnalyzedResources
methods.description: Lists resources that have been analyzed.
